purpose: test whether infinitesimal future-learning response adds chronology information beyond passive loss recency and K2/K3 endpoint geometry on the already-observed four-stage pilot codebook
candidate_generation: construct all 24 K2 and K3 candidate parameter predictions from one exact ordered interaction basis measured through K3; do not train the 24 candidate histories directly
target_policy: regenerate all 24 already-observed pilot histories and require their endpoint hashes to match the frozen replay lock before response scoring
response_definition: for each state compute four stage losses and four stage gradient vectors; first-order challenge response is S_ab=<grad L_a, grad L_b>
candidate_response_normalization: fit mean and standard deviation from the 24 candidate reference fingerprints only; drop reference coordinates with std<=1e-12; never fit normalization on target responses
response_decoder: Euclidean nearest candidate in reference-standardized response coordinates
primary_active_adds_information_requires: K3 primary-response full-order correct strictly greater than frozen K3 endpoint 3/24
K3 primary-response full-order correct strictly greater than frozen recency 1/24
K3 primary-response prefix-depth-3 correct at least 3/24
K3 primary-response pairwise precedence correct at least 79/144
K3 primary-response candidate reference fingerprints have positive minimum separation
strong_low_order_rescue_descriptor: report whether K2 primary-response full-order recovery reaches or exceeds the frozen K3 endpoint result of 3/24; this is descriptive and not required for the primary gate
finite_challenge_policy: do not run actual continuation updates unless the infinitesimal susceptibility gate is promising; if promising, freeze epsilon sweep before finite-challenge outputs
interpretation_scope: methodology development on an already-spent codebook only; no result from this pilot counts as held-out confirmation
next_step_if_primary_gate_passes: freeze and run a finite-challenge Taylor-validation pilot on this same spent codebook before touching held-out confirmation
next_step_if_primary_gate_fails: do not expose held-out codebooks; classify first-order active response as not yet providing the required additional chronology channel and repair or abandon the method on spent data only
